# Upstream

This folder is an unchanged copy of `skills/agentify-website/` from the Open Agentic
Web Challenge repository:

- Repository: https://github.com/cognizant-ai-labs/agentic-web
- Commit: 05165377aca457381bd41b5c05e7a26cd23e6d74 (2026-11-19)
- License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`, copied from the repository root; `runtime/LICENSE.txt`
  covers the nsdeploy runtime)

Do not edit these files. Each NearShelf site copies `runtime/` from here unchanged, and
builds and serves with the scripts in `scripts/`. To update, export a newer commit with
`git archive` (LF line endings) and replace the folder.
